{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor dampeners''' were countermeasures used to disrupt [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] during private meetings. The conference room on [[Petabys Station]] used sensor dampeners and soundproofing to provide security and privacy during use.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
